A '''slicewire''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] available to [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]]. The one-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long cord was molecule-thin and wrapped around [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] handles on each end and was strong enough to cut through most materials, even [[Duranium/Legends|duranium]] and [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]]. It could be used in a manner similar to a [[Garrote/Legends|garrote]], or swung like a lash at enemies. The danger of handling this weapon meant it was only issued to expert users.<ref name="ROE" />
